body:
![Banner](https://i.imgur.com/p9lNs6l.png) # The Dark Mode Resource Pack for Minecraft: Java Edition
[Release](https://github.com/nebuIr/Default-Dark-Mode/releases/latest) [License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) [CurseForge Downloads](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/default-dark-mode/files) [Darkomizer Downloads](https://darkomizer.com) Default Dark Mode gives the Minecraft GUI a darker look while maintaining the vanilla textures. [![Darkomizer](https://i.imgur.com/R0tc2H8.png)](https://darkomizer.com) ## Compatibility Minecraft: Java Edition **1.6** through **1.21** is supported. *Optional: [Optifine](https://optifine.net/) is required for the dark loading screen.* ## Mod Support Want support for a specific mod? Create an issue and submit a mod support request [here](https://github.com/nebuIr/Default-Dark-Mode/issues/new/choose).\ Before submitting a mod support request, please make sure that your mod has not already been requested in another issue.
